slides.plain_text:
2026 Q1 Reserve Review
Quarterly actuarial reserve review
Reporting group: Demo Insurance Group
Entities: Demo Insurance UK; Demo Insurance Europe
Valuation date: 2026-03-31
Reporting currency: GBP

slides.title: Executive Summary
slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 4m to GBP 614m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 4m to GBP 614m
Total reserve: GBP 614m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 4m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,860.1m
The principal increases were Casualty +GBP 6m and Property +GBP 1m.
Motor released GBP 1m following favourable development.
Marine released GBP 2m following favourable development.
40 projection-method selections changed since 2025 Q4, concentrated in Casualty and Marine and Motor and Property.
Some areas have stabilised, but Casualty uncertainty remains elevated; this quarter is the baseline for the Q2 comparison.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Casualty: strengthened GBP 6m. Recent accident years remain the principal focus; strengthening reflects sustained adverse emergence.
Marine: released GBP 2m. Favourable development has supported a measured release.
Property: strengthened GBP 1m. Experience is within expectation; catastrophe exposure is monitored seasonally.
Motor: released GBP 1m. Frequency and severity trends remain within expectation.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Casualty uncertainty remains elevated despite stabilisation elsewhere; attritional emergence in accident years 2022 to 2024 is still above long-term expectation.
Marine continues to develop favourably; further releases will be considered only with sustained evidence.
Motor has released modestly; frequency trends remain within expectation.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
A comparatively quiet quarter. Casualty remains the key focus area going into the mid-year review.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 614m
